props.name: TokenProps
rows: Slot for the label of the token as text or an element. For `variant="inline"`, only plain text is supported, for example, strings or numbers.
Adds an `aria-label` to the token. Use this if the label is not plain text.
A label tag that provides additional guidance, shown next to the label.
Further information about the token that appears below the label.
A list of tags giving further guidance about the token.
An icon at the start of the token. When `variant="normal"`, if a description or tags are set, icon size should be `normal`. When `variant="inline"`, icon size should be `small`.
Specifies the token's visual style and functionality. For `inline` only label, icon and dismiss button are displayed. Defaults to `normal` if not specified.
Determines whether the token is disabled.
Specifies if the control is read-only. A read-only control is still focusable.
Adds an `aria-label` to the dismiss button.
Called when the user clicks on the dismiss button. Make sure that you add a listener to this event to update your application state.
Content to display in the tooltip when `variant="inline"`. The tooltip appears when the token label is truncated due to insufficient space. Only applies to plain text labels.
An object containing CSS properties to customize the token's visual appearance. Refer to the [style](/components/token/?tabId=style) tab for more details. @awsuiSystem core
